workspaceKey.description: Workspace key with evaluations:write scope. Never send it to native storage or model providers.

QuoteInput.description: Pinned-client request requires explicit set_id. The server retains older optional-set requests; checkpoint comparisons must never select the newest set implicitly. New frozen protocols and private models currently require qualified direct mode; unsupported harness/turn/source bounds fail closed. max_new_tokens is per model turn; max_episode_tokens covers prompt/history/tool transcript. Seed must be explicit for checkpoint comparisons. telecom-episode-v1 requires explicit thinking:true for its pinned reasoning renderer and parser.
